{{Nickname}}
The '''Directors''' was the name adopted by the three [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] [[Grees]], [[Emala]], and [[Sligh]] in the years following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Establishing a working relationship with [[the Colony]], they worked out a number of import and export deals in which they received a good percentage of the profit. With a friendship with worlds in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Squibs' double-billing of shipments gained them high profits.

At the time of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], it was discovered that the Directors were supplying the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] with transport vessels that were being used to stage military coups on the homeworlds of various insectile races. Before things could get out of hand, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] uncovered the plot and warned the Alliance. Though Thyferra was affected, the Directors lost most of their profit with the destruction of most of their stock.
